tools.name: search_archive
tools.description: Full-text search over indexed frontier research papers, clinical trials and research dossiers (AI, quantum computing, superconductivity, medicine, energy, astrophysics, mathematics). Returns ranked records with highlighted snippets, identifiers and links. Free.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List the archive topics (optionally for one domain) with paper counts and whether a premium dossier exists. Free.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: Topic overview: description, key concepts, dossier preview, the most influential and the newest papers. Free.

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description: Full metadata for one record by archive id (arxiv:<id>, doi:<doi>, pmc:<PMCID>, nct:<NCT id>, openalex:<W id>), including the abstract when its license allows. Free.

tools.name: preview_dossier
tools.description: Free preview of a premium dossier: summary, table of contents, statistics, verification record and two sample claims.

tools.name: get_dossier
tools.description: PAID per call via x402. Full research dossier: state-of-the-field synthesis plus structured claims mapped to citations, quantitative benchmarks, timeline, open problems, glossary and resolved bibliography. Price: $0.20 (USDC on Base Sepolia (testnet), x402).

tools.name: get_research_pack
tools.description: PAID per call via x402. Topic research pack: the topic dossier plus the 50 most influential and 25 newest papers (licensed abstracts included) and related clinical trials. Price: $0.20 (USDC on Base Sepolia (testnet), x402).
